text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—I've got this!
None stand before me now!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan
text_block_list.text:
OGUUUUURIII!!
Don't lose! Give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...I can feel it...! What incredible momentum!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Like I'd ever let youuuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki! It's Yaeno Muteki!!
Taking first place is Yaeno Mutekiii!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Victory...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(However, to think Oguri-san
would extend her lead like that in the final stretch...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(During the race, I didn't feel much of that
scorching, overwhelming pressure from Oguri-san.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Composed, yet with a razor-sharp stride...
Just like the flow of pure, clear water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Her running style is completely different from mine.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I felt that strength.
We will surely cross paths again someday."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the waiting room, Yaeno Muteki was her usual self,
showing no signs of getting carried away by victory.
choice_data_list: Congratulations! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I was able to run today without wearing myself out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Far more steadily than in her debut race,
she managed to achieve the union of fire and water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With this, even the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki shows a flash of confidence with a fearless smile.
It seems she's feeling good about the upcoming Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And soon after, the days of training
for the Satsuki Sho began.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence.
Are you out for roadwork too, Yaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, to serve as a warm-up as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Mainichi Hai!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Even the TV commentators were raving about it!
Saying a promising new star has arrived on the Classic scene!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but scream out, "Whoa, this is bad!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, that's how I honestly feel, though... Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's Ardan-san getting out of the taxi.
I wonder if she went somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san, were you out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I had gone to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling unwell...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just a regular clinic visit.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "I have decided to forgo running in the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The toll from the debut race was heavier than expected...
and it sounds like her recovery will take some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Satsuki Sho in top form will be difficult.
In that case, I will wager everything on my greatest goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To achieve a radiant crown just like my elder sister,
who etched her name into magnificent history, I too shall—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the "Japanese Derby."
I shall go forth to claim the pinnacle of Classic glory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: For the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Spending ample time and ensuring rock-solid conditioning,
I will take on the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though my body may be as fragile as glass,
I have not the slightest intention of yielding.
From this moment on, everything is for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to watching
both of your performances closely at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Indeed, please feast your eyes upon this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
If you'll excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Ardan-san will not be running,
what I must do remains unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Win the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I won't give up either!!
I'm not losing to Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san,
let us meet on the track at the Satsuki Sho.
